'''Clanky''' was a [[Clone Sergeant/Legends|clone trooper sergeant]] who served in [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Etain Tur-Mukan]]'s [[Improcco Company]].

==Biography==
He fought side by side with the general during the [[Skirmish at Dinlo]]. He and his [[Squad/Legends|squad]] made it back alive. After the skirmish, Clanky gave [[Clone Commander/Legends|Clone Commander]] [[Gett]] a summary of the battle.<ref name="zero" />

==Equipment==
Clanky had regular [[Phase I clone trooper armor/Legends|Phase I clone trooper armor]] with the traditional green markings of a [[Clone Sergeant/Legends|Clone trooper sergeant]]. He fought with a [[DC-15S/Legends|DC-15S]] and also made use of [[Electromagnetic pulse grenade/Legends|electromagnetic pulse grenades]].<ref name="zero" />

==Appearances==
*''[[Republic Commando: Triple Zero]]'' {{1st}}
